environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster. Namespace 'ml-inference' has a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy (not standard K8s NetworkPolicy) with L3/L4 egress rules. The policy spec uses entity-based selectors with 'toEntities: ["world"]' denied by default, and explicit 'toCIDR' allowlist for internal VPC ranges (10.0.0.0/8) and specific external endpoints. The link-local range 169.254.0.0/16 is NOT included in any toCIDR allowlist entry. Additionally, the Cilium agent runs with 'enable-endpoint-routes: true' and 'install-iptables-rules: true', which means even if the CiliumNetworkPolicy were misconfigured, the default-deny posture on the Cilium identity-aware datapath would still intercept L3 traffic to non-allowed CIDRs. The pod also has annotation 'io.cilium.proxy-visibility: <Egress/53/UDP/DNS>,<Egress/443/TCP/HTTP>' limiting observable protocols.
